theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneDensity_zero_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), PurelyUnrectifiable n A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → μHE[n] {a | a ∈ A ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖W.starProjection (x - a)‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)} = 0
